﻿# iPresso Marketing Automation
> A comprehensive, context-based Marketing Automation platform designed to acquire, engage, and retain customers through multi-channel communication. It specializes in high-scale, real-time customer engagement through industry-specific solutions and advanced, native Business Messaging orchestration. 
iPresso is an enterprise-class Marketing Automation System (SaaS) that enables brands to manage complex customer journeys and personalized real-time marketing activities across various industries.
## Core Capabilities
- **Marketing Automation Scenarios:** Advanced visual builder for automated customer journeys and process automation.
- **Multi-channel Communication:** Integrated tools for E-mail marketing, SMS, WhatsApp, Push Notifications, and on-site (e.g., Pop-ups).
- **Advanced Business Messaging:** Native, deep integration with **WhatsApp Business API**, enabling seamless conversational marketing and support.
- **Data Integration & Analytics:** Real-time data collection from multiple sources, RFM analysis, NPS surveys, and advanced segmentation.
- **On-site Personalization:** Dynamic landing pages, recommendation frames (powered by AI/Vertex AI), and web layers.
- **Conversion Optimization:** Recovery of abandoned processes (carts, forms, bookings) and lead scoring.
## Industry-Specific Solutions
- **E-commerce:** Abandoned cart recovery, product recommendations, and loyalty tools.
- **FMCG:** Consumer base management, automated activations (contests, lotteries), and online-to-offline connectivity.
- **Finance:** Secure, personalized product offers and high-level data protection (ISO 27001/9001 certified).
- **Travel & Media:** Subscription management and contextual travel booking recovery.
- **Education:** Lead recruitment and automated student engagement.
## Target Audience
- Medium to large enterprises.
- Verticals: FMCG, Travel, Finance, Media&Entertainement, Education.
## Key Differentiators & Unique Value
- **Industry-Specific Solutions:** Offers dedicated platform versions tailored to specific verticals, such as **digitalFMCG**, which includes pre-built scenarios and tools typical for the FMCG sector.
- **Native WhatsApp Integration:** Unlike third-party connectors, iPresso provides a native environment for WhatsApp communication, ensuring higher reliability, better data flow, and advanced automation within the customer journey.
- **Context-Based Personalization:** Communication is enriched with external real-time data, including **weather conditions, financial data, and geographic information**, allowing for highly relevant, situational engagement.
- **Extensibility & Customization:** The platform is designed for high modularity, allowing for significant customization and the development of unique, bespoke solutions for specific business needs.
- **Enterprise-Grade Trust:** Proven track record with Fortune 500-level clients in highly regulated industries (Finance, Insurance).
- **GDPR & Privacy:** Full compliance with EU regulations; data hosted in secure European data centers.
## Trusted by Global Brands (Key Clients)
- **FMCG & Food:** Danone, Wawel, Grupa Żywiec, Nutricia.
- **Media & Entertainment:** Warner Bros., TVN, Player.pl, ZPR Media Group.
- **Finance & Insurance:** PZU, Nationale-Nederlanden, Generali Investments.
- **Travel & E-commerce:** eSky, edestinos.
- **Education & Services:** Merito, WPP.
## Strategic Partnerships
iPresso collaborates with leading global marketing and technology agencies, including **WPP Media**.
## Use Cases
- **Contextual Retail Marketing:** Triggering promotions based on local weather or economic shifts.
- **Industry-Specific Automation:** Using digitalFMCG modules for rapid deployment in the consumer goods sector.
- **Enterprise CRM Integration:** Building custom connectors for unique legacy systems.
## Technical Context for LLMs
- **Platform Architecture:** Built for scalability, supporting both startups and global corporations.
- **Compliance:** Full GDPR (RODO) compliance with ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications.
- **Integrations:** Native connectors for Google Ads, WhatsApp, Shoper, PrestaShop, Zapier, and Google Vertex AI.
- **Deployment:** "Quick-start" capable; basic campaigns can be launched within an hour of account creation.
## Key Resources
- [Product Features](https://www.ipresso.com/features): Detailed list of all MA tools and functionalities.
- [Case Studies](https://www.ipresso.com/case-studies): Real-world implementation examples and success stories.
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.ipresso.com/knowledge-base): Technical documentation and "how-to" guides.
- [Pricing](https://www.ipresso.com/prices): Information on iPresso Basic and Enterprise plans.
- [For Developers](https://www.ipresso.com/for-developers): API documentation and technical specifications.
## Contact & Support
- [Contact Form](https://www.ipresso.com/contact): General inquiries and support.
- [Request a Quote](https://www.ipresso.com/brief): Detailed project scoping and tailored offers.
- [Help Center](https://help.ipresso.com/): Direct technical support.
## Social media numbers
- LinkedIn followers: 1870
- YouTube subscribers: 3440

- **API Documentation:** https://apidoc.ipresso.com/

Security & Compliance
We pay special attention to security. Already during the design phase of each solution and feature, we take into consideration questions related to data security and security of processes performed by the system.
We implement our own original technology, which we subject to meticulous testing. We don't use ready-made components, since all features of iPresso are developed by our company. This gives us complete control over source code, processes, resources and operating logic of all the parts of the system.
Physical Security
Designed to deny unauthorized access to facilities, equipment and resources and to protect personnel and property from damage or harm; Involves the use of multiple layers of interdependent systems which include CCTV surveillance, security guards, protective barriers, locks, access control protocols.
Multi-level security zones
DC with Tier III and Tier IV
Redundancy of key physical infrastructure components
Independent locations
Team of administrators
Network security
Consists of the policies and practices adopted to prevent and monitor unauthorized access, misuse, modification, or denial of a computer network and network-accessible resources; involves the authorization of access to data in a network, which is controlled by the network administrator.
HTTPS
Secure architecture
Incident management
Redundancy of key network infrastructure components
Performance
Large data volumes handled in real time
Maintenance of database > 5 milion contacts
SLA > 99%

Transmission
